parsing_traps: Per-property valuations are disclosed in the marketing Portfolio Profiles section in GBP millions (pp.38-57); the audited Statement of Financial Position / Note 4 discloses only an AGGREGATE investment-property figure (fair value GBP 424,660k; carrying GBP 425,873k incl. lease liabilities). Per-property market_valuation therefore taken from the marketing list (x1,000,000); Sum = GBP 425.1m, reconciles to headline portfolio value GBP 424.7m (rounding in GBP'm) and to Note 4 fair value GBP 424.66m.
North West table (p38) has an extra blank column after the 'Valuation as at' header; column offset handled in the adapter.
Some pages list columns as 'Valuation' first, others as 'Annualised...' first; both map to the same 5 data columns (val, annualised GRI, actual rent received, purchase price, NIA).

Headline Revenue GBP 38.0m / NPI GBP 36.0m EXCLUDE straight-line rent adjustments; audited Revenue is GBP 36,590k and audited NPI GBP 34,623k INCLUDE them. financial.json and performance use the AUDITED figures. total_revenue = Revenue 36,590 + Other property income 1,715 = 38,305 so that gross_income (total - opex) ties to audited NPI 34,623.
Aggregate leverage has two disclosed bases: 42.8% per Property Funds Appendix (used for performance.aggregate_leverage) vs 40.7% net gearing. cost_of_debt uses disclosed 'Borrowing cost' 4.7%.
Scotland tenure disclosed as 'heritable interest' = freehold equivalent -> land_tenure=Freehold.

data_provenance.basis: Note 24 EPU: 'Weighted average number of Units' = 603,241 '000 -> 603,241,000 absolute
Note 24: 'diluted earnings per Unit is the same as the basic earnings per Unit as there were no outstanding anti-dilutive Units' -> diluted = basic 603,241,000. Verified correct.

Note 23 Amount Available for Distribution: FY2025 distributable income = 19,303 £'000 (Profit 13,869 + distribution adjustments 5,434), matching headline 'Distributable income £19.3m'. Verified = distributable-income-for-year line, not distributions paid (17,933) nor cumulative available (27,274). Already correct.
Method 1: acquisition fee paid in Units added back as a non-cash distribution adjustment (Note 23 Note A, p161). Single distributable-income figure; no separate cash-deducted adjusted line -> null.

Note 23 (£'000): for-the-year distributable income 19,303 (Profit 13,869 + adj 5,434) less explicit 'Amount retained for general corporate and working capital (Retention)' 965 = 18,338 after-retention amount to be distributed for FY2025. Distinct from net_distributable_income 19,303 (pre-retention). Retained = 19,303 - 18,338 = 965 £'000 (matches the disclosed Retention line; positive). NOT the cumulative 'Amount available' 27,274 (incl opening 8,936) nor cash distributions paid 17,933 (mixes prior-year final). Ties to DPU 3.03p.
Phase-1 tag 2026-06-23: distribution_paid is the disclosed for-the-year amount-to-be-distributed (after retention); NDI - distribution_paid = the disclosed retention.
